help:
Usage: rewamp [OPTIONS] [FILES...]

Without options, FILES open the usual "play now / next / at the end" choice.
When Rewamp is already running, the command goes to it;
otherwise Rewamp starts with it (e.g. rewamp --mini --play song.mod).

Options:
  --play         Replace the queue with FILES and start playing.
  --next         Insert FILES right after the current track.
  --enqueue      Append FILES to the end of the queue.
  --shuffle      Play FILES in random order.
  --subsong N    Start a multi-track FILE at its N-th track (1-based).
  --play-pause   Toggle play / pause.
  --next-track   Skip to the next track.
  --prev-track   Go back to the previous track.
  --stop         Stop playback.
  --mini         Switch to the mini player (with --viz: its visualizer mode).
  --window       Use the normal window (leaves the mini player; overrides a start in the mini player).
  --viz          Open the player on the visualizer.
  --fullscreen   Open the player on the visualizer, full screen.
  --search TEXT  Open Search with TEXT.
  --help         Show this help and exit.
  --version      Show the version and exit.
